title: Distribution-preserving cold STNFS transfer to bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the algorithm in proof.md returns P in G1 for the exact supplied uniform nonidentity Q in G2 and independent uniform z in GT, satisfying e(P,Q)=z, with success at least 0.39 conditional on all inherited, explicitly disclosed H1-H5 heuristics in source-core.md. Total cold classical work, including preprocessing, both logs, all failures and the new wrapper, is bounded by 2^122.04 target-operation units at C=20000. Peak storage is below 2^106 bytes, preprocessing is bounded by the full total, no external advice or cross-target amortization is assumed. The complete inherited core evidence is supplied; no prior review verdict is a premise. This is an analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run. The numerical conversion and distribution argument do not establish the inherited kernel or NFS premises. The entire inherited core cost is multiplied by 101/100 as a conservative implementation-price reserve, without lowering any failure allowance.
